s01748.summary: Attorney Nadia opens a deposition of Elias in a converted bowling alley.
Nadia presses Elias on lending eleven million of pension money to his own company.
Exhibit Nine shows his signed note to hide the transfer from trustees.
Elias rises and slams the table; Nadia calmly notes he became agitated.
Elias sits deflated, recalls being happy here, and asks her to repeat the question.

s00743.summary: An elevator carrying two lawyers and a bailiff stalls; the judge phones demanding them.
Trapped, Nkiru and Wyatt snipe about who made an offer; the bailiff would take it.
Lights return and the elevator drops with a lurch.

s00194_0.summary: Drifter Colton asks Maggie for work and gets quizzed, jokes landing awkwardly.
Maggie hires him but quietly tells Beau to watch him over cut fence wires.

s01451.summary: Conrad meets Helena in the dining car and they spar while a porter listens.
Conrad accuses her of giving the Havilland papers to the Senator and slaps the table.
Conrad sits and concedes she is smarter; she tells him to eat his oysters.

s01160.summary: Professor Ellwood senses someone on the stair; Velma from the Royal Society appears.
Velma says he failed to report a comet and lays anonymous plates on the table.
Ellwood admits the comet moved the wrong way and his instruments were fine.
He offers cold traditional tea and Velma laughs and accepts.

s01612.summary: Cassius rides an empty school bus at dawn and chats briefly with the driver.
Winnie sits across from Cassius and they admit being scared of the Calc exam.
They quiz each other, and Cassius reveals he studied more than he said.

s02092.summary: Constable Quill asks lamplighter Toby about a woman in a green shawl; Toby lies.
Violets spill revealing the shawl; Mrs. Finnegan tells Toby to run and hurls her basket.

s02308.summary: Two officers and a teen explorer search an abandoned nursery school as a music box plays.
The pale girl in yellow turns and sweetly announces nap time.

s01648.summary: Zofia pries a grate in a cheese cave and plays a recorded message from herself.
Following the tape, she cuts open a Brie and finds a rubber thumb.
Footsteps overhead; she kills her headlamp, then uses the thumb to open the vault.

s00885.summary: The Wheel Club meets in a junkyard bus clubhouse, teasing and listing summer plans.
Ruthie raises the new-locked trunk and Teddy presses Danny about who owns it.
Danny says his brother told him to keep it safe; Ruthie reveals the key.
Ruthie opens the trunk revealing photographs of local children and a Polaroid of the four taken that morning.

s00236.summary: At a ferret's funeral, Hector's irreverent anecdotes irk Gerry and the director.
Dennis phones in a hamster rumor mid-prayer, derailing the service.
Nibbles sits up alive in the casket and Gerry sobs with joy.
Bea offers a refund, then Nibbles bites her, vindicating Hector's count.

s01544_1.summary: Descending the stairwell, Nestor thanks Cass for calling him a doctor.
Colette breaks the basement padlock and they find the old radio room.
Nestor broadcasts into the mic as friends steady him and a faint voice answers.

s01694.summary: Boy Finnegan asks the witch for a cure for his feverish sister.
Sibylle dismisses silver and he offers his father's bone whistle.
She returns the whistle, gives him the cure, and he runs home; she holds its twin.

s02376.summary: In a car wash, Greg and Samir argue and Adaeze tries to stay calm.
Adaeze brakes and orders both out, stepping into the foam.

s01683.summary: Lucky and Nate load a duffel into a car in a flooded garage.
A van arrives and Detective Marisol demands their hands up at gunpoint.
Marisol fires a warning shot; Nate releases Lucky who sprints for the stairwell.

s01500.summary: Prosecutor Ellis offers a deal and Defender Noreen rejects it in a supply closet.
They question juror Desmond about the defendant's sister speaking to him.
Ellis thanks Desmond and dismisses him; the lawyers trade parting jabs.

s01888.summary: Laila reveals only eleven days of rations remain and accuses the Captain of hoarding.
The three struggle over the crate and bars scatter across the floor.
Ashworth admits the extra bars are for Tavita's child on the Hab.

s00981.summary: Rafaela flicks a lighter near nitrate film while June protests.
A film can ignites and the girls smother the flames, coughing.
Mr. Kowalczyk finds the burnt reel, shrugs it off as a bad print, and forgives them.

s00718.summary: Seven stranded passengers on a snowbound bus ration water and burn what they have.
A garbled radio message promises help by morning, then dies.
Ranger Tobias enters to rescue them; Kit insists the girl and mother go first.

s00350.summary: Injured Dez and Archie sit in a tilted mine cage hanging by a frayed cable.
Dez sends the lightest man, Archie, up the cable to the ladder.
Archie climbs as the cable strands snap and the cage drops.
The cable breaks, the cage falls, and Dez's faint voice tells Archie to climb.

s00150.summary: Speakeasy players bicker over the deal while a silent stranger watches.
The stranger identifies himself as Callum Redfern, heir to a cellar of four hundred barrels.
Callum seeks partners, lays down a straight flush, and Horace toasts the cellar.

s00902.summary: Sunny joins Jamal on the school roof and teases him about skipping practice.

s02429.summary: At Bea's birthday, her hen Penelope escapes and Theo needles his mother.
Grandpa Oswalde arrives and gives Bea a hand-carved coop sign.
Mrs. Petrakis brings pie and the hen pecks the cake, making everyone laugh.

s01954.summary: VP Gordon announces a realignment through a megaphone as staff dismiss him.
Fitz's flash blinds Gordon and a voice summons him to corporate.
Gordon trudges to the elevator while staff pity him mildly.

s02022.summary: Three crew fight to seal the airlock hatch against a banging outside force.
The wheel locks and Nadir says the thing knows they are inside.

s01725.summary: Stranger Felix arrives at the curling club ten minutes early after a scheduling mix-up.
Greta welcomes him, hands over her broom, and Bjorn pours a fourth cup.

s02318.summary: Dez and Callum prepare to pry open a scratched iron door despite Rhonda's protest.
The door gives, something hisses, and the bulb dies; Rhonda says something is breathing.
Light returns and Rhonda is gone; her cheerful voice calls them inside.

s00985.summary: Nonna teaches Emeka to hear good pickle jars while Tamsin watches silently.
Tamsin says she must leave; Nonna answers without turning; Emeka asks to stay.
A stranger arrives, saying he is Bartosz, son of Janek the tinsmith.
Nonna recalls Janek, gives Bartosz a jar to listen to, and Tamsin sits by her son.

s01786_0.summary: A tin ice-fishing shack sits on a windswept frozen lake, smoke rising.
